# Neighbour ground truth — the query set B-033's floor is derived from.
#
# NOT recall-spec.md §3.1's nine queries. Re-deriving the neighbour floor against the
# same rows that validated B-008 would be circular: the number would be chosen to make
# those rows produce links. These fifteen are a separate set, and every label below was
# written from the corpus slug list alone, before any score was measured — the git
# history is the evidence, since this file lands in the same commit as the "before"
# golden and one commit ahead of the sweep that reads it.
#
# A label answers DESIGN §5.3's question — "what should a NEW note on this topic link
# to" — not "what does the scorer rank highly". Queries are deliberately adjacent-topic:
# a note that would be created, near notes that already exist.
#
# Format: a Q: line, then one "- <slug>" per expected neighbour. Slug is the note's
# filename without .md, matching recall.Candidate.Slug. Blank lines and # are ignored.
